generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Integrate verified components into target product interfaces, data flows, and production-oriented operational boundaries.

contract.purpose_user_function: Integrate verified components into product interfaces, data flows, and operational boundaries.
contract.valid_inputs: Verified component, target interface/API/data flow, compatibility contract, migration/config, deployment boundary, tests, and rollback.
contract.expected_outputs: Integrated product change plus migration/config, compatibility evidence, and rollback plan.
contract.state_side_effects: Modifies product code/config/data flow and may run integration/migration checks in authorized environments.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Interface mismatch, migration failure, regression, policy/security issue, missing rollback, or target-environment unavailability blocks release.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: No universal integration engine exists; integrations are task-specific code-agent work under plan/gate controls.
contract.success_evidence: Target interface/data flow works end to end, regressions pass, and rollback/migration evidence is recorded.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: interface contract; data flow; migration; backward compatibility; regression; rollback; target unavailable.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/plan_validator.py and operator dispatch; task-specific integrations under integrations/ and harness/integrations/
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/plan_validator.py and operator dispatch; task-specific integrations under integrations/ and harness/integrations/
